text: The purpose of this report is to provide details on the current status of the Ontario Line project within the boundaries of Toronto and East York Community Council (TEYCC), including timelines, construction mitigation plans, and community engagement milestones. On July 19, 2023, City Council adopted TM1.2 - City of Toronto Recommendations for Metrolinx's Ontario Line Construction within the Toronto and East York District to fulfill the Ontario Line Subcommittee’s ('Subcommittee') mandate by consolidating City staff recommendations while incorporating public feedback provided throughout the Subcommittee’s duration, reflecting on City Council directives, and providing a clear and comprehensive package of initiatives that the Province and Metrolinx should implement to construct the Ontario Line.
